missed.claim: ICDAR 2023 IHTR winner Upstage KR: avg CRR 95.94% but WRR only 88.31% across 10 scripts.
IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS (Gongidi, Jawahar, ICDAR 2021): 868K handwritten word instances, 135 writers, 8 scripts incl Bengali; best CER 9.64% (10K pretrain) / 4.97% (82K pretrain).
PLATTER + CHIPS (IIIT-H/IITB, arXiv 2502.06172): page-level Indic handwriting recognizer, tested on Bengali among 7 scripts; competed ICDAR 2025 IHDR; Stage-3b handwriting base candidate.
SemiHastakshar (IIIT-H, Dec 2025): semi-supervised Indic handwriting OCR on IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS + HW-WILD + HW-UC, reports WER/CER vs PARSeq HTR baseline.
Hybrid dewarp (YOLOv8 + cubic polynomial) lowest median CER 0.0235 on IWILT; Mistral OCR 3 $2/1000 pages ($1 batch) at LEDGER:394 (cited range 393-396 correct).
